Name: Rainbow Horse
Author: Pixxlpanda
Description:
[size=4][center]Recolors the horse to give it a rainbow colored mane and tail with either a black or white body.﻿[/center]


[/size][size=3][b][i]How to use this mod:[/i][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher installed[/size]
[*][size=3]download this mod, unzip it and add it to your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder[/size]
[*][size=3]run the game once so the config file is created[/size]
[*][size=3]if you want to change the color of your horse, change the [i]config.json[/i] file as described below[/size]
[/list]
[i]
[/i][size=3][b][i]How to change the config.json file:[/i][/b]
You can choose to either have a black or white horse. Set "[i]color[/i]" accordingly to "[i]black" [/i]or "[i]white"[/i]. The default setting is black.[/size]
